soccer use the competition slug directly (`eng.1`, `esp.1`, `uefa.champions`).
The CDN covers ESPN's front-page leagues only (no `nhl`). gameId comes from the
scoreboard op. Every request carries ?xhr=1 (added by default). Browse
espn://cdn/operations.

tools.name: espn_core_call
tools.desc:
Gateway to the ESPN core data model (sports.core.api.espn.com). The deepest,
most canonical surface: athletes + statistics + career logs, per-event odds /
win-probabilities / plays / situation / broadcasts / predictor / power-index,
per-competitor line-scores + statistics, season teams/coaches/draft/futures,
venues, leaders, rankings, franchises and coaches. NOTE the path uses
`leagues/{league}` (plural). Supply `operation` + `path_params` (sport, league,
plus eventId/competitionId/athleteId/year as needed). Most responses use ESPN's
$ref-linked envelope ({count, items:[{$ref}]}); follow the refs for detail.
Browse every operation in the espn://core/operations resource.

tools.name: espn_game_summary
tools.desc:
Full summary for one game: box score, scoring plays, drives/play-by-play,
leaders, win-probability and odds. `event` is an id from espn_scoreboard. No
example here on purpose — it needs a live event id, so the doctor probes
espn_scoreboard instead.
tools.example: {boxscore:{teams, players}, plays:[...], scoringPlays:[...], leaders:[...], winprobability:[...]}

tools.name: espn_news
tools.desc:
League news feed: recent articles (headline, description, links, images,
related athletes/teams) for one league.
tools.example: {header, articles:[{headline, description, published, links, categories}]}

tools.name: espn_scoreboard
tools.desc:
Scoreboard for one league: today's (or a given date's) games with status,
clock, live scores and event ids. The fastest way to get the `event` ids that
espn_game_summary / espn_core_call (event_*) need. sport+league are slugs, e.g.
football/nfl, basketball/nba, soccer/eng.1.
tools.example: {leagues:[...], events:[{id, name, status, competitions:[{competitors:[{team, score}]}]}]}

tools.name: espn_site_call
tools.desc:
Gateway to the ESPN site API resource families (site.api.espn.com). Supply an
`operation` plus a `path_params` map containing at least `sport` + `league`
(slugs like football/nfl, basketball/nba) and any id the op needs (teamId,
athleteId), then optional `query_params`. Covers team detail/rosters/schedules/
injuries/depth-charts/transactions/history, athlete news, conference/division
groups and poll rankings. For athlete profiles/game-logs/splits use
espn_web_call (or espn_core_call for the canonical model). Browse every
operation in the espn://site/operations resource.

tools.name: espn_standings
tools.desc:
League standings / ladder: per-team wins, losses, win %, conference/division
groupings for the current (or a given) season.
tools.example: {name, children:[{standings:{entries:[{team, stats:[{name, value}]}]}}]} (children = conferences/divisions)

tools.name: espn_teams
tools.desc:
Team catalogue for one league: every team with id, name, abbreviation, colours
and logos. Use the team ids with espn_site_call (team_roster, team_schedule, …).
tools.example: {sports:[{leagues:[{teams:[{team:{id, displayName, abbreviation}}]}]}]}

tools.name: espn_web_call
tools.desc:
Gateway to the ESPN web API (site.web.api.espn.com): site-wide search across
teams/athletes/leagues, plus the common/v3 athlete views (overview, stats,
gamelog, splits) that power player profile pages, and statistics-by-athlete.
`search` needs only query_params {query, limit}; the athlete_* ops need
path_params {sport, league, athleteId}. Browse the espn://web/operations resource.

tools.desc: Week box scores — each matchup with both lineups, per-player actual and projected points. The start/sit post-mortem view.

tools.name: espnfantasy_communication
tools.desc: League message board / activity feed (chat topics, trade chatter, activity posts). 404s when the league has no communication group.

tools.name: espnfantasy_draft

tools.name: espnfantasy_league_settings

tools.example: {MRData:{StandingsTable:{season, round, StandingsLists:[{season, round, DriverStandings:[{position, points, wins, Driver:{driverId, code, familyName}, Constructors:[{constructorId, name}]}]}]}}}  — note the extra StandingsLists layer

tools.name: jolpicaf1_drivers
tools.desc: Drivers — all-time, or the field for one season.
tools.example: {MRData:{DriverTable:{season, Drivers:[{driverId, permanentNumber, code, givenName, familyName, dateOfBirth, nationality, url}]}}}  — `driverId` (e.g. 'max_verstappen') is the key every other tool filters on

tools.name: jolpicaf1_laps
tools.desc: Lap-by-lap times for every driver in a race. LARGE — page it or narrow to one lap.
tools.example: {MRData:{total, RaceTable:{Races:[{Laps:[{number, Timings:[{driverId, position, time}]}]}]}}}  — one entry per lap, each holding every driver's timing

tools.name: jolpicaf1_pitstops
tools.desc: Pit stops for a race: lap, time of day and stationary duration.
tools.example: {MRData:{RaceTable:{Races:[{PitStops:[{driverId, lap, stop, time, duration}]}]}}}  — `duration` is stationary time ('23.2'), `time` is clock time of day

tools.name: jolpicaf1_qualifying
tools.desc: Qualifying results with Q1/Q2/Q3 times per driver.
tools.example: {MRData:{RaceTable:{Races:[{QualifyingResults:[{position, Driver, Constructor, Q1, Q2, Q3}]}]}}}  — Q2/Q3 absent for drivers eliminated earlier

tools.name: jolpicaf1_races
tools.desc: A season's race calendar with dates, circuits and (from 2021) each session's date/time.
tools.example: {MRData:{RaceTable:{season, Races:[{season, round, raceName, date, time, url, Circuit:{circuitId, circuitName, Location}, FirstPractice, Qualifying, Sprint}]}}}  — `round` is what the result tools take

tools.name: jolpicaf1_results
tools.desc: Race results: finishing order, grid, laps, time/status, points and fastest lap.
tools.example: {MRData:{RaceTable:{Races:[{season, round, raceName, Results:[{position, positionText, points, grid, laps, status, Driver:{driverId, code}, Constructor:{constructorId}, Time:{millis, time}, FastestLap:{rank, lap, Time, AverageSpeed}}]}]}}}  — all values are STRINGS

tools.name: jolpicaf1_seasons
tools.desc: Every F1 season on record (1950 onward).
tools.example: {MRData:{total, limit, offset, SeasonTable:{Seasons:[{season, url}]}}}

tools.name: jolpicaf1_sprint
tools.desc: Sprint race results (weekends that have one — 2021 onward).
tools.example: {MRData:{RaceTable:{Races:[{SprintResults:[{position, points, grid, laps, status, Driver, Constructor, Time}]}]}}}  — Races is EMPTY for a weekend with no sprint, which is not an error

tools.name: kalshi_candlesticks
tools.desc: OHLC price candlesticks for one market over a time window (1m/1h/1d periods).
tools.example: {ticker, candlesticks:[{end_period_ts, yes_bid, yes_ask, price, volume, open_interest}]}

tools.name: kalshi_candlesticks_batch
tools.desc: OHLC candlesticks for MANY markets in one call — pass the tickers as a list.
tools.example: {markets:[{market_ticker, candlesticks:[{end_period_ts, price, volume, open_interest}]}]}

tools.name: kalshi_event
tools.desc: One event by ticker, optionally with its markets embedded.
tools.example: {event:{event_ticker, series_ticker, title, category, mutually_exclusive, markets:[…]}, markets}

tools.name: kalshi_events
tools.desc: Event catalogue (an event groups related markets) — filter by series or status. Paginated by cursor.
tools.example: {cursor, events:[{event_ticker, series_ticker, title, sub_title, category, mutually_exclusive, strike_period}], milestones}

tools.name: kalshi_exchange_announcements
tools.desc: Active exchange-wide announcements.
tools.example: {announcements:[{type, message, delivery_time, status}]}

tools.name: kalshi_exchange_schedule
tools.desc: Standard trading hours + maintenance windows.
tools.example: {schedule:{standard_hours, maintenance_windows}}

tools.name: kalshi_exchange_status
tools.desc: Is the exchange up and trading right now.
tools.example: {exchange_active, trading_active}

tools.name: kalshi_market
tools.desc: One market's full detail by ticker — quotes, volume, rules, strike, timing.
tools.example: {market:{ticker, event_ticker, title, yes_sub_title, no_sub_title, status, result, yes_bid_dollars, yes_ask_dollars, last_price_dollars, volume_fp, open_interest_fp, rules_primary, rules_secondary, strike_type, custom_strike, open_time, close_time, expiration_time}}

tools.name: kalshi_markets
tools.desc: Prediction-market catalogue with current quotes — filter by event/series ticker or status. Paginated by cursor.
tools.example: {cursor, markets:[{ticker, event_ticker, market_type, title, status, yes_bid_dollars, yes_ask_dollars, no_bid_dollars, no_ask_dollars, last_price_dollars, volume_fp, volume_24h_fp, open_interest_fp, liquidity_dollars, open_time, close_time, expiration_time, rules_primary}]}

tools.name: kalshi_milestones
tools.desc: Milestones — dated catalysts (data releases, games, decisions) linked to the event tickers they resolve.
tools.example: {cursor, milestones:[{id, category, details, end_date, primary_event_tickers, related_event_tickers}]}

tools.name: kalshi_mve_collection
tools.desc: One multivariate event collection by ticker.
tools.example: {multivariate_contract:{collection_ticker, series_ticker, title, description, associated_events, associated_event_tickers}}

tools.name: kalshi_mve_collections
tools.desc: Multivariate event collections — the parlay-style combo products that many KXMVE* markets belong to (a market's mve_collection_ticker points here).
tools.example: {cursor, multivariate_contracts:[{collection_ticker, series_ticker, title, description, is_ordered, is_all_yes, size_min, size_max, associated_event_tickers, open_date, close_date}]}

tools.name: kalshi_orderbook
tools.desc: Order book for one market — resting yes/no bids by price level (dollar-denominated).
tools.example: {orderbook_fp:{yes_dollars:[[price, size], …], no_dollars:[[price, size], …]}}  (empty arrays when nothing is resting)

tools.name: kalshi_series
tools.desc: One series by ticker — title, category, settlement sources, fee structure.
tools.example: {series:{ticker, title, category, frequency, tags, settlement_sources, contract_url, fee_type}}

tools.name: kalshi_series_list
tools.desc: All series in a category (Sports, Politics, Economics, Financials, Climate and Weather, Entertainment, …) — the top of the id chain.
tools.example: {series:[{ticker, title, category, frequency, tags, settlement_sources, contract_url}]}

tools.name: kalshi_structured_target
tools.desc: One structured target (entity) by id.
tools.example: {structured_target:{id, name, type, details, source_ids}}

tools.name: kalshi_structured_targets
tools.desc: Structured targets — Kalshi's entity registry (players, companies, people) that markets resolve against. Paginated by cursor; page size via page_size.
tools.example: {cursor, structured_targets:[{id, name, type, details, source_ids, last_updated_ts}]}

tools.name: kalshi_trades
tools.desc: Recent public trades, optionally for one market ticker. Paginated by cursor.
tools.example: {cursor, trades:[{trade_id, ticker, count, yes_price, no_price, taker_side, created_time}]}

tools.name: laliga_competition
tools.desc: One competition by SLUG (e.g. primera-division). Numeric id 404s — use the slug.
tools.example: {competition:{id, slug, name, opta_id}}

tools.name: laliga_competitions
tools.desc: All LaLiga competitions (men's/women's, primera/segunda, across history), each with slug, opta_id, name.
tools.example: {competitions:[{id, slug, name, opta_id, lde_id, main}]}

tools.name: laliga_match
tools.desc: One match by SLUG (from laliga_matches; the long temporada-… slug, not the numeric id which 404s). For a played match adds scores + formations.
tools.example: {match:{id, slug, name, home_team, away_team, home_score, away_score, home_formation, away_formation, competition, gameweek, date, status, attempt, ball}}

tools.name: laliga_matches
tools.desc: Matches feed. IMPORTANT: pass competition= to get a competition's matches — subscription= alone returns a mixed bag (incl. World Cup placeholders). competition=primera-division gives the 380 LALIGA EA SPORTS matches; add gameweek= for one matchweek (10).
tools.example: {total, matches:[{id, slug, name, opta_id, home_team, away_team, competition, season, gameweek, date, time, venue, status}]}  (status FullTime/PreMatch/…)

tools.name: laliga_player
tools.desc: One player profile by SLUG — name, firstname/lastname, date_of_birth, country, current team + squad, roles.
tools.example: {player:{id, slug, name, firstname, lastname, date_of_birth, country, international, team, squad, roles}}

tools.name: laliga_player_stats
tools.desc: One player's Opta stats[] by SLUG.
tools.example: {player_stats:{id, name, slug, opta_id, team, stats:[{name, stat}]}}

tools.name: laliga_players_stats
tools.desc: EVERY player in a season (≈749) with full Opta stats[] (name/stat pairs) + position + team + opta_id. Page with limit (max 100) + offset.
tools.example: {total, player_stats:[{id, name, slug, opta_id, shirt_number, position, country, team, stats:[{name, stat}]}]}

tools.name: laliga_rounds
tools.desc: Rounds / matchweeks structure for a season (gameweeks, groups).
tools.example: {total, rounds:[{id, slug, name, position, num_gameweeks, gameweeks, has_groups, groups}]}

tools.name: laliga_squad
tools.desc: A club's CURRENT squad — each entry has person (name, date_of_birth, country, height), photos, position id, shirt_number, opta_id, loan status. (The subscription arg is required by the API but the roster returned is the current one, not season-historical.)
tools.example: {total, squads:[{id, opta_id, person:{name, date_of_birth, country, height}, photos, position, shirt_number, role, current, loan}]}

tools.name: laliga_standing
tools.desc: Full league table for a season — 20 entries with played/won/drawn/lost/goals_for/goals_against/goal_difference/points/position + full team object (shield, colours).
tools.example: {total, standings:[{position, previous_position, played, won, drawn, lost, goals_for, goals_against, goal_difference, points, team:{id, slug, name, shortname, opta_id, shield}}]}

tools.name: laliga_subscription
tools.desc: One season instance by slug — competition, year, season name, current gameweek, rounds, and `teams` (the authoritative 20 teams in that season — use this, not laliga_teams, for a season roster).
tools.example: {subscription:{id, slug, name, competition, season, season_name, year, current_gameweek, teams:[20 season teams], rounds}}

tools.name: laliga_subscriptions
tools.desc: Season instances (a 'subscription' = one competition's season), paginated 20/page. Each has slug, competition, year, current_gameweek, date range.
tools.example: {total, subscriptions:[{id, name, slug, competition, year, current_gameweek, date_ini, date_end, rounds}]}

tools.name: laliga_team
tools.desc: One team by SLUG — club info, colours, foundation, socials, competitions, venue.
tools.example: {team:{id, slug, name, shortname, opta_id, club, color, foundation, competitions, last_main_competition}}

tools.name: laliga_teams
tools.desc: Global team directory across all competitions (~1541), paginated — use it to resolve a team's slug/id/opta_id. NOTE: NOT season-scoped; for the 20 teams in a season read laliga_standing or laliga_subscription (its embedded `teams`).
tools.example: {total, teams:[{id, slug, name, nickname, shortname, boundname, shield, competitions}]}  (opta_id present on most; join via it where available)

tools.name: lichess_daily_puzzle
tools.desc: The daily puzzle: the position, the solution line, and the game it came from.
tools.example: {game:{id, perf:{key, name}, rated, players:[{name, color, rating}], pgn, clock}, puzzle:{id, rating, plays, solution:[uci moves], themes:[str], initialPly}}

tools.name: lichess_leaderboard
tools.desc: Top-rated players for one time control or variant.
tools.example: {users:[{id, username, title, perfs:{<perf>:{rating, progress}}, online}]}

tools.name: lichess_leaderboards_all
tools.desc: Top 10 for EVERY time control and variant in a single call.
tools.example: {bullet:[{id, username, title, perfs}], blitz:[…], rapid:[…], classical:[…], chess960:[…], atomic:[…], …}  — one array per perf

tools.name: lichess_tournaments
tools.desc: Arena tournaments — currently running, finished and upcoming.
tools.example: {created:[{id, fullName, startsAt, variant, clock, nbPlayers}], started:[…], finished:[…]}  — three lists by state, NOT one

tools.name: lichess_user
tools.desc: A Lichess player: ratings per time control and variant, games played, play time and profile.
tools.example: {id, username, title, perfs:{bullet:{rating, games, rd, prog}, blitz:{…}, rapid:{…}, classical:{…}, correspondence:{…}, puzzle:{…}}, createdAt, seenAt, playTime:{total, tv}, count:{all, rated, win, loss, draw}, profile:{…}, patron, streamer}  — no single 'rating': read perfs.<timeControl>.rating

tools.name: lichess_users_status
tools.desc: Online/playing status for up to 50 users in one call — who is available right now.
tools.example: [{id, name, title, online, playing, streaming, patron}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: mlb_allstar_ballot
tools.desc: All-Star Game ballot candidates for a league + season.
tools.example: {league, candidates:[{position, players:[{person, team}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_allstar_final_vote
tools.desc: All-Star 'Final Vote' candidates for a league + season.
tools.example: {league, candidates:[{person, team, position}]}

tools.name: mlb_allstar_writeins
tools.desc: All-Star write-in candidates for a league + season.
tools.example: {league, writeIns:[{person, team, position}]}

tools.name: mlb_attendance
tools.desc: Attendance figures for a team or league/season — per-game and aggregate home/away/total gate.
tools.example: {records:[{openings, attendanceTotal, attendanceAverage, team, season}], aggregateTotals}

tools.name: mlb_awards
tools.desc: Recipients of an award — e.g. MLBHOF (Hall of Fame), ALMVP/NLMVP, ALCY/NLCY (Cy Young), ALROY/NLROY (Rookie of the Year). Discover awardIds with mlb_awards_list.
tools.example: {awards:[{id, name, season, player, team, votes}]}

tools.name: mlb_awards_list
tools.desc: Award definitions catalogue — every awardId with name, description and sport (the id lookup for mlb_awards).
tools.example: {awards:[{id, name, description, sortOrder, sport, active}]}

tools.name: mlb_boxscore
tools.desc: Full game boxscore — both teams' batting + pitching lines per player, team totals, officials and top performers.
tools.example: {teams:{away:{team, teamStats, players:{ID#:{stats:{batting,pitching}, position}}}, home:{...}}, officials, topPerformers}

tools.name: mlb_conferences
tools.desc: Conference catalogue (used by some leagues / amateur levels).
tools.example: {conferences:[{id, name, abbreviation, league, hasWildcard}]}

tools.name: mlb_datacasters
tools.desc: Datacaster (official scorer-adjacent stringer) assignments.
tools.example: {roster:[{person, job}]}

tools.name: mlb_divisions
tools.desc: Division catalogue (AL/NL East, Central, West) with their league + sport links.
tools.example: {divisions:[{id, name, nameShort, abbreviation, league, sport}]}

tools.name: mlb_draft
tools.desc: MLB Rule 4 draft results for a year — picks with player, school/team, position and signing info. Filter by round.
tools.example: {drafts:{draftYear, rounds:[{round, picks:[{pickNumber, person, team, school, position}]}]}}

tools.name: mlb_draft_prospects
tools.desc: Draft prospects for a year (the pre-draft prospect board).
tools.example: {prospects:[{id, rank, person, school, position}]}

tools.name: mlb_free_agents
tools.desc: Free agents for a season — players and their from/to-team signing info.
tools.example: {freeAgents:[{player, originalTeam, newTeam, dateSigned, dateDeclared, position]}]}

tools.name: mlb_game_changes
tools.desc: Games changed since a timestamp — a polling helper to detect updated games.
tools.example: {totalItems, dates:[{games:[{gamePk, gameDate}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_game_content
tools.desc: Editorial / media content for a game — highlights, recap, media, and (when present) the box-score-and-storylines bundle.
tools.example: {editorial, media, highlights, summary, gameNotes}

tools.name: mlb_game_context_metrics
tools.desc: Context metrics for a game — leverage, win-probability and run-expectancy context for the current/most-recent state.
tools.example: {game, leverageIndex, homeWinProbability, awayWinProbability}

tools.name: mlb_game_pace
tools.desc: Game-pace / tempo metrics for a season (pitches per game, time of game, etc.), optionally by team.
tools.example: {sports:[{...pace}], teams:[{team, ...pace}], leagues:[...]}

tools.name: mlb_game_uniforms
tools.desc: Uniforms worn in one or more games.
tools.example: {uniforms:[{gamePk, home:{...}, away:{...}}]}

tools.name: mlb_game_win_probability
tools.desc: Win-probability time series for a game — WP after each play, with leverage index.
tools.example: [{atBatIndex, homeTeamWinProbability, awayTeamWinProbability, leverageIndex, homeTeamWinProbabilityAdded}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: mlb_high_low
tools.desc: High / low stat records for an org level — top and bottom performances for a sortStat in a season.
tools.example: {highLow:[{statType, splits:[{stat, player|team}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_home_run_derby
tools.desc: Home Run Derby bracket + results for a derby gamePk.
tools.example: {info, status, rounds:[{matchups:[{topSeed, bottomSeed, ...}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_jobs
tools.desc: People holding a job type for a season — jobType e.g. UMPR (umpires), SCORER, DATACASTER, BROADCASTER, COACH.
tools.example: {roster:[{person, jobType, job}]}

tools.name: mlb_leaders
tools.desc: League leaders for one or more categories (homeRuns, battingAverage, era, strikeouts, wins, saves, ...).
tools.example: {leagueLeaders:[{leaderCategory, statGroup, season, leaders:[{rank, value, person, team}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_leagues
tools.desc: League catalogue — e.g. American League (103) and National League (104). Pass sportId=1 for MLB.
tools.example: {leagues:[{id, name, abbreviation, sport, seasonState, hasWildCard}]}

tools.name: mlb_linescore
tools.desc: Game linescore — runs per inning, R/H/E totals, current inning + state, and on-base/defense for live games.
tools.example: {currentInning, inningState, isTopInning, innings:[{num, home:{runs,hits,errors}, away:{...}}], teams:{home:{runs,hits,errors}, away:{...}}}

tools.name: mlb_live_feed
tools.desc: The complete live game feed (v1.1) — gameData (teams, players, venue, weather, probables) + liveData (boxscore, linescore, full plays). The firehose; large.
tools.example: {gamePk, gameData:{teams, players, venue, weather, probablePitchers}, liveData:{plays, linescore, boxscore, decisions}}

tools.name: mlb_meta
tools.desc: Meta lookup — fetch the valid values for a parameter used elsewhere (stat types, positions, game types, pitch codes, etc.). One tool over the API's /{type} endpoint.
tools.example: [{...lookup rows}]  (shape depends on type; e.g. positions → [{code, name, type, abbrev}])

tools.name: mlb_official_scorers
tools.desc: Official scorer assignments.
tools.example: {roster:[{person, job}]}

tools.name: mlb_people
tools.desc: Batch player profiles for a list of personIds (the multi-id form of mlb_player).
tools.example: {people:[{id, fullName, primaryNumber, birthDate, primaryPosition, batSide, pitchHand, currentTeam}]}

tools.name: mlb_people_changes
tools.desc: Player records changed since a timestamp — a polling/sync helper (the people-side sibling of mlb_game_changes).
tools.example: {people:[{id, fullName, currentAge, birthDate, active, primaryPosition, batSide, pitchHand}]}  (can be large for a wide window)

tools.name: mlb_playbyplay
tools.desc: Pitch-by-pitch / play-by-play log — every plate appearance with result, pitches, counts, runners and scoring-play flags.
tools.example: {allPlays:[{result, about:{inning,halfInning,isScoringPlay}, matchup:{batter,pitcher}, playEvents:[...], count}], scoringPlays, currentPlay}

tools.name: mlb_player
tools.desc: Player biographical profile — name, DOB, bats/throws, height/weight, position, debut, current team. One personId.
tools.example: {people:[{id, fullName, primaryNumber, birthDate, currentAge, height, weight, primaryPosition, batSide, pitchHand, mlbDebutDate, currentTeam}]}

tools.name: mlb_player_game_stats
tools.desc: One player's stat line for one specific game (batting/pitching/fielding for that gamePk).
tools.example: {stats:[{group, splits:[{stat:{...}, game}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_player_search
tools.desc: Find players by name — resolves a name to personId(s) and basic bio.
tools.example: {people:[{id, fullName, firstName, lastName, birthDate, primaryPosition}]}

tools.name: mlb_player_stats
tools.desc: One player's stats — by type (season / career / yearByYear / gameLog) and group (hitting/pitching/fielding).
tools.example: {stats:[{type, group, splits:[{season, stat:{...}, team, league}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_schedule
tools.desc: Game schedule — by single date or startDate/endDate range, optionally for one team. Each game carries gamePk, status, teams and score.
tools.example: {totalGames, dates:[{date, games:[{gamePk, gameDate, status, teams:{away:{team,score}, home:{team,score}}, venue}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_schedule_postseason
tools.desc: Postseason schedule — all playoff games (optionally a single season / series type).
tools.example: {totalGames, dates:[{date, games:[{gamePk, seriesDescription, teams, status}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_schedule_postseason_series
tools.desc: Postseason series view — games grouped by series (e.g. ALDS, NLCS, World Series).
tools.example: {series:[{series:{id, gameType}, totalItems, games:[...]}]}

tools.name: mlb_schedule_postseason_tunein
tools.desc: Postseason broadcast 'tune-in' info (where/when to watch playoff games).
tools.example: {dates:[{games:[{gamePk, broadcasts:[...]}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_schedule_tied
tools.desc: Tie-breaker / tied games for a season.
tools.example: {totalGames, dates:[{games:[...]}]}

tools.name: mlb_season
tools.desc: Single season detail by seasonId — key dates and game-count info.
tools.example: {seasons:[{seasonId, regularSeasonStartDate, regularSeasonEndDate, postSeasonStartDate, postSeasonEndDate}]}

tools.name: mlb_seasons
tools.desc: Season catalogue with key dates (regular-season start/end, postseason, etc.). Pass sportId=1.
tools.example: {seasons:[{seasonId, regularSeasonStartDate, regularSeasonEndDate, seasonStartDate, seasonEndDate, preSeasonStartDate, postSeasonEndDate}]}

tools.name: mlb_seasons_all
tools.desc: Every season in MLB history (151+) with key dates — the /seasons/all catalogue. (Plain /seasons only returns the current season; an ?all=true query there is a no-op.)
tools.example: {seasons:[{seasonId, regularSeasonStartDate, regularSeasonEndDate, seasonStartDate, seasonEndDate, preSeasonStartDate, qualifierPlateAppearances, hasWildcard}]}

tools.name: mlb_sports
tools.desc: Sport catalogue — the sportId lookup (1 = Major League Baseball; others are MiLB levels, college, international).
tools.example: {sports:[{id, code, name, abbreviation, sortOrder, activeStatus}]}

tools.name: mlb_sports_players
tools.desc: All players in a sport for a season — the full player catalogue (name → id resolution). sportId=1 for MLB.
tools.example: {people:[{id, fullName, firstName, lastName, primaryNumber, birthDate, currentAge}]}  (large)

tools.name: mlb_standings
tools.desc: Division standings — per-team W/L, pct, GB, streak, run differential, wild-card and division ranks. Pass leagueId (103=AL, 104=NL).
tools.example: {records:[{division, league, teamRecords:[{team, wins, losses, winningPercentage, gamesBack, streak, runDifferential, divisionRank, wildCardRank}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_stats
tools.desc: Season stats query across players — by group (hitting/pitching/fielding) and type (season, career, byDateRange, ...). Sort + limit for top-N tables.
tools.example: {stats:[{type, group, splits:[{season, player, team, stat:{...}}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_team
tools.desc: Single team detail by id — name, league/division, venue, colours, founding.
tools.example: {teams:[{id, name, abbreviation, league, division, venue, locationName, firstYearOfPlay}]}

tools.name: mlb_team_alumni
tools.desc: Former players (alumni) for a team in a season + group (hitting/pitching/fielding).
tools.example: {people:[{id, fullName, primaryPosition, mlbDebutDate}]}

tools.name: mlb_team_coaches
tools.desc: A team's coaching staff — manager, hitting/pitching/bench coaches, etc.
tools.example: {roster:[{person, jobId, job, title}], teamId}

tools.name: mlb_team_leaders
tools.desc: A team's statistical leaders for given categories (e.g. homeRuns, era) in a season.
tools.example: {teamLeaders:[{leaderCategory, season, leaders:[{rank, value, person}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_team_personnel
tools.desc: A team's front-office / non-uniformed personnel.
tools.example: {roster:[{person, job, title}], teamId}

tools.name: mlb_team_roster
tools.desc: A team's roster — players with position and jersey number. rosterType selects active / 40-man / full-season / depth chart.
tools.example: {roster:[{person:{id, fullName}, jerseyNumber, position:{abbreviation, name}, status}], teamId, rosterType}

tools.name: mlb_team_stats
tools.desc: One team's aggregate stats — by season + group (hitting/pitching/fielding) and stat type.
tools.example: {stats:[{type, group, splits:[{season, team, stat:{...}}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_team_uniforms
tools.desc: Uniform assets / descriptions for one or more teams.
tools.example: {uniforms:[{teamId, uniformAssets:[{uniformAssetText, uniformAssetType, ...}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_teams
tools.desc: Team catalogue — id, name, abbreviation, location, league/division, home venue. Pass sportId=1 for the 30 MLB clubs.
tools.example: {teams:[{id, name, abbreviation, teamName, locationName, league, division, venue, firstYearOfPlay}]}

tools.name: mlb_teams_affiliates
tools.desc: A club's affiliated teams across the minor-league levels.
tools.example: {teams:[{id, name, sport, league, parentOrgId, parentOrgName}]}

tools.name: mlb_teams_history
tools.desc: Franchise history (name/league/division changes over time) for one or more teams.
tools.example: {teams:[{id, name, season, league, division, locationName, active}]}

tools.name: mlb_teams_stats
tools.desc: Aggregate stats across all teams — league-wide team leaderboard by season + group. Sort + limit for top-N.
tools.example: {stats:[{type, group, splits:[{team, stat:{...}}]}]}

tools.name: mlb_transactions
tools.desc: Roster transactions — signings, trades, call-ups, IL moves, DFA, etc. Filter by team, player, single date or date range.
tools.example: {transactions:[{id, person, fromTeam, toTeam, date, typeCode, typeDesc, description]}]}

tools.name: mlb_umpires
tools.desc: Current umpire crew list.
tools.example: {roster:[{person, jobType, job}]}

tools.name: mlb_venues
tools.desc: Venue detail for one or more venueIds — name, location, field/roof info.
tools.example: {venues:[{id, name, location, fieldInfo, timeZone, active}]}

tools.name: motogp_categories
tools.desc: The classes running at one event — MotoGP, Moto2, Moto3, MotoE.
tools.example: [{id (uuid), name:'MotoGP™', legacy_id}]  — `id` is the categoryUuid the session and standings tools need

tools.name: motogp_events
tools.desc: The Grand Prix weekends in a season, with circuit, country and dates.
tools.example: [{id (uuid), name, short_name:'QAT', sponsored_name, date_start, date_end, circuit:{id, name, nation}, country:{iso, name}, season, event_files}]

tools.name: motogp_seasons
tools.desc: Every MotoGP season (1949 →) with its uuid — the entry point to everything else.
tools.example: [{id (uuid), year, current}]  (top-level array, newest first) — `id` is the seasonUuid every other tool needs; `current: true` marks the live season

tools.name: motogp_session_classification
tools.desc: The result of one session: finishing order, rider, team, bike, time/gap and points.
tools.example: {classification:[{position, points, total_laps, time, gap:{first, lap}, rider:{id, full_name, number, country}, team:{name}, constructor:{name}, average_speed, top_speed, status}], records, file}

tools.name: motogp_sessions
tools.desc: The sessions for one class at one event — practice, qualifying, sprint and race.
tools.example: [{id (uuid), type:'RAC'|'SPR'|'Q1'|'Q2'|'FP1'|'PR', number, date, condition:{track, air, humidity, ground, weather}}]  — pick type 'RAC' for the race

tools.name: motogp_standings
tools.desc: Championship standings for one class in one season.
tools.example: {classification:[{position, points, rider:{id, full_name, number, country}, team:{name}, constructor:{name}}], file}

tools.name: mysportsfeeds_boxscore
tools.desc: Full box score for one game, team and player level.
tools.example: {game:{…}, scoring:{…}, stats:{away:{teamStats:[…], players:[{player:{id, firstName, lastName, position}, playerStats:[…]}]}, home:{…}}}

tools.name: mysportsfeeds_games
tools.desc: Games for a season in one league, with scores and venue.
tools.example: {lastUpdatedOn, games:[{schedule:{id, week, startTime, awayTeam:{id, abbreviation}, homeTeam:{…}, venue, playedStatus}, score:{awayScoreTotal, homeScoreTotal, quarters|periods|innings:[…], currentQuarter, currentIntermission}}]}

tools.name: mysportsfeeds_injuries
tools.desc: Current injury list for a league.
tools.example: {players:[{id, firstName, lastName, position, currentTeam:{abbreviation}, currentInjury:{description, playingProbability}}]}

tools.name: mysportsfeeds_player_gamelogs
tools.desc: Per-game statistics for players across a season — the cleanest surface this API has.
tools.example: {gamelogs:[{game:{id, startTime, awayTeamAbbreviation, homeTeamAbbreviation}, player:{id, firstName, lastName, position, jerseyNumber}, team:{id, abbreviation}, stats:{…sport-specific groups…}}]}

tools.name: mysportsfeeds_standings
tools.desc: Standings for a league and season.
tools.example: {teams:[{team:{id, abbreviation, city, name}, stats:{standings:{wins, losses, winPct, gamesBack}}, divisionRank:{rank, gamesBack}, conferenceRank:{…}, overallRank:{…}}]}

tools.name: nascar_race_list
tools.desc: Every race in a season across all three series, with winner, track, distance, cautions and lead changes. LARGE (~430 KB).
tools.example: {series_1:[{race_id, series_id, race_season, race_name, track_name, track_id, date_scheduled, scheduled_distance, actual_laps, number_of_cautions, number_of_lead_changes, average_speed, margin_of_victory, pole_winner_driver_id, winner_driver_id, attendance}], series_2:[…], series_3:[…]}  — series 1=Cup, 2=Xfinity, 3=Truck

tools.name: nascar_weekend_feed
tools.desc: One race weekend in full: the finishing order with laps led, points and status, plus every practice and qualifying run.
tools.example: {weekend_race:[{race_id, race_name, track_name, results:[{finishing_position, starting_position, car_number, driver_fullname, team_name, laps_completed, laps_led, points_earned, status, delta_leader}], caution_segments, race_comments}], weekend_runs:[{run_type, run_name, results:[{finishing_position, driver_name, best_lap_time, best_lap_speed}]}]}  — `weekend_race` is the race, `weekend_runs` is p

tools.name: nba_boxscore
tools.desc:
Live/final box score for one game from the CDN: per-player and per-team stat
lines, by period. gameId comes from nba_scoreboard_today or nba_schedule.
tools.example: {game:{gameId, homeTeam:{teamId, players:[{name, statistics}]}, awayTeam:{...}}}

tools.name: nba_daily_lineups
tools.desc:
Projected/confirmed starting lineups for a date's games, from the stats.nba.com
JS data feed. date is YYYYMMDD.
tools.example: {games:[{gameId, homeTeam, awayTeam, lineups}]} (feed shape varies)

tools.name: nba_odds_today
tools.desc:
Sportsbook odds for today's games from the live CDN odds feed (spread, money
line, total per game and book).
tools.example: {games:[{gameId, markets:[{name, books:[{name, outcomes:[...]}]}]}]}

tools.name: nba_playbyplay
tools.desc:
Event-level play-by-play log for one game from the CDN: every action with clock,
score, player and description. gameId from nba_scoreboard_today / nba_schedule.
tools.example: {game:{gameId, actions:[{actionNumber, period, clock, scoreHome, scoreAway, description}]}}

tools.name: nba_schedule
tools.desc:
Full league schedule for the current season (every game, date, broadcasters,
arena). Large payload (~8 MB) — prefer nba_scoreboard_today for just today.
tools.example: {leagueSchedule:{seasonYear, gameDates:[{gameDate, games:[{gameId, homeTeam, awayTeam, ...}]}]}}

tools.name: nba_scoreboard_today
tools.desc:
Today's games from the live CDN scoreboard: matchups, period/clock state, live
scores and game ids. The fastest way to get today's gameId values for nba_boxscore
/ nba_playbyplay.
tools.example: {scoreboard:{gameDate, games:[{gameId, gameStatus, gameStatusText, period, gameClock, homeTeam, awayTeam}]}}

tools.name: nba_stats_call
tools.desc:
Gateway to the stats.nba.com /stats/ analytics API (138 operations). Supply an
`operation` (the /stats/ path segment, e.g. "leaguedashplayerstats",
"shotchartdetail", "boxscoretraditionalv3", "playercareerstats") plus a
`query_params` map; each operation already carries NBA's full default param set,
so override only the fields you need (e.g. {Season: "2024-25", PlayerID: "201939"}).
Browse every operation, its required params and its defaults in the
nba://stats/operations resource. Most responses are column-oriented
({resultSets:[{name, headers, rowSet}]}); zip headers with each row.

tools.name: nbl_ladder
tools.desc: The NBL ladder (standings) for one season — 10 clubs with position, played/won/lost, points_percentage, win_percentage, points_for/against, last_5 and current streak. `year` is the season start year (2025 = current NBL26).
tools.example: {type, count, data:[{id, position, played, won, lost, points_percentage, win_percentage, points_for, points_against, last_5, streak, team}]}

tools.name: nbl_match_outcomes
tools.desc: Per-team match outcomes (results) for a season — win/loss rows by team, for head-to-head and form analysis.
tools.example: {type, count, data:[{team, …per-match outcome rows}]}

tools.name: nbl_news
tools.desc: NBL news articles (latest ~200) — each with title, slug, body (HTML), excerpt, sub_headline, byline, published_date, categories/tags, a related_player and match_slug link, and featured_image_url. NOTE: this feed returns a RAW ARRAY (not the {type,count,data} envelope). Use `limit` to cap rows.
tools.example: array of {id, status, title, slug, body, excerpt, sub_headline, byline, published_date, categories, tags, related_player, match_slug, featured_image_url, likes}  (RAW ARRAY, not enveloped)

tools.name: nbl_next_matches
tools.desc: Upcoming matches across all NBL teams for a season (empty in the deep off-season). For the full fixture incl. completed games use nbl_schedule.
tools.example: {type, count, data:[{id, start_time, round, home_team, away_team}]}

tools.name: nbl_player_boxscores
tools.desc: Game-by-game box scores for one player across a season — per match the points/rebounds/assists/blocks/steals/turnovers and playing position. The score-series / game-log source.
tools.example: {type, count, data:[{period, playing_position, points, rebounds, assists, blocks, steals, turnovers}]}

tools.name: nbl_player_stats
tools.desc: Season statistics for one player — points/rebounds/assists/blocks/steals/turnovers and their per-game averages, shooting splits (field goals / three-pointers / free throws made-attempted-percentage), fouls, minutes. playerId is the player UUID from nbl_players.
tools.example: {type, count, data:[{points_average, rebounds_total_average, assists_average, blocks_average, steals_average, turnovers_average, field_goals_percentage, three_pointers_percentage, free_throws_percentage, fouls_average, minutes}]}

tools.name: nbl_players
tools.desc: All players for one season (~165) — each with jersey_number, playing_position and embedded player {id, first_name, last_name, …}, team and season objects. The player `id` (UUID) feeds nbl_player_stats / nbl_player_boxscores.
tools.example: {type, count, data:[{jersey_number, playing_position, player:{id, first_name, last_name}, team:{id, name, team_code}, season}]}

tools.name: nbl_schedule
tools.desc: Every match for one season — each with start_time, round, match_status (complete/upcoming/live), home/away scores, attendance, match_slug/title, a play_by_play flag, the Genius external_id, and full home_team/away_team objects (name, team_code, logos, colours). `seasonType=all` for the whole season.
tools.example: {type, count, data:[{id, external_id, start_time, round, match_status, home_score, away_score, attendance, match_slug, match_title, play_by_play, home_team:{id, name, team_code, team_logo, color_primary}, away_team:{…}}]}

tools.name: nbl_season_current
tools.desc: The current season(s). Convenience shortcut over nbl_seasons; may return empty in the deep off-season (the call still resolves). Use `limit` to cap rows.
tools.example: {type, count, data:[{id, name, year, season_type, external_id, start_date, end_date}]}

tools.name: nbl_seasons
tools.desc: Every NBL season (~73: NBL27, NBL26, blitz/preseason/tournament variants…), each with id (UUID), name, year (season start year), season_type, the Genius external_id, and start/end dates. The discovery entry point — take a season's `id` for nbl_stat_leaders, or its `year` for the year-scoped feeds. Current regular season is the latest `year` with season_type=regular.
tools.example: {type, count, source, data:[{id, name, year, season_type, external_id, start_date, end_date, competition}]}

tools.name: nbl_stat_leaders
tools.desc: Season statistical leaders (points/rebounds/assists/etc. averages, per player) for one season — pass the season UUID (`seasonId`) from nbl_seasons (data[].id), NOT the year. Use `limit` to cap rows (limit=-1 for all).
tools.example: {type, count, data:[{player, team, points_average, rebounds_total_average, assists_average, field_goals_percentage, three_pointers_made_average, …}]}

tools.name: nbl_team_roster
tools.desc: One team's roster for a season. teamId comes from the team objects in nbl_players / nbl_schedule / nbl_ladder.
tools.example: {type, count, data:[{jersey_number, playing_position, player:{id, first_name, last_name}, team}]}

tools.name: nbl_team_stats
tools.desc: Team statistics for a season — totals and per-game averages across assists, rebounds (offensive/defensive), blocks, steals, turnovers, and shooting (field goals / three-pointers / free throws made-attempted-percentage).
tools.example: {type, count, data:[{team, assists, assists_average, defensive_rebounds, blocks, steals, turnovers, field_goals_made, field_goals_attempted, field_goals_percentage, three_pointers_percentage}]}

tools.name: nbl_teams
tools.desc: The NBL club catalogue (~78 incl. historical/relocated franchises) — each with id (UUID), name, team_code, team_nickname, logos and brand colours. Join team_id from nbl_players / nbl_schedule back to here.
tools.example: {type, count, data:[{id, external_id, name, team_code, team_nickname, team_logo, color_primary, color_secondary}]}

tools.name: ncaa_rankings
tools.desc: Poll rankings — AP, coaches and others — for a college sport and division.
tools.example: {sport, title, updated, page, pages, data:[{RANK, SCHOOL, POINTS, PREVIOUS, RECORD}]}  — keys here are UPPERCASE, unlike standings

tools.name: ncaa_scoreboard
tools.desc: Current scoreboard for one college sport and division — games with scores, state and clock.
tools.example: {updated_at, games:[{game:{gameID, startDate, startTime, gameState, currentPeriod, contestClock, home:{names:{short, full}, score, winner, conferences}, away:{…}, url, network}}]}  — note each entry is a one-key object wrapping `game`

tools.name: ncaa_standings
tools.desc: Conference standings for a college sport and division.
tools.example: {sport, title, updated, page, pages, data:[{conference:'ACC', standings:[{School, 'Conference W', 'Conference L', 'Overall W', 'Overall L', 'Overall PF', 'Overall PA', 'Overall HOME', 'Overall AWAY', 'Overall STREAK'}]}]}  — GROUPED BY CONFERENCE: data[] is one entry per conference, each holding its own `standings` list. The inner column names are human-readable strings WITH SPACES and vary by spo

tools.name: nhl_boxscore
tools.desc: Full box score for one game: both lineups with goals, assists, plus-minus, shots, hits, blocks and time on ice.
tools.example: {id, gameDate, gameState, gameOutcome, homeTeam:{abbrev, score, sog}, awayTeam:{…}, playerByGameStats:{homeTeam:{forwards:[{playerId, name, goals, assists, points, plusMinus, sog, hits, blockedShots, toi}], defense:[…], goalies:[…]}, awayTeam:{…}}, clock, periodDescriptor}

tools.name: nhl_club_schedule
tools.desc: One club's entire season schedule with results — the team game log.
tools.example: {games:[{id, gameDate, gameType, gameState, homeTeam:{abbrev, score}, awayTeam:{abbrev, score}, gameOutcome:{lastPeriodType}, venue, neutralSite}], currentSeason, previousSeason, nextSeason, clubTimezone}  (~200 KB for a full season)

tools.name: nhl_game_landing
tools.desc: Game landing page: scoring summary by period, three stars, penalties and team game stats.
tools.example: {id, gameDate, gameState, homeTeam, awayTeam, summary:{scoring:[{periodDescriptor, goals:[{timeInPeriod, firstName, lastName, assists, strength}]}], penalties:[…], threeStars:[…], teamGameStats:[…]}, clock}

tools.name: nhl_goalie_leaders
tools.desc: League leaders among goalies — wins, save percentage, goals-against average and shutouts.
tools.example: {wins:[{id, firstName:{default}, lastName:{default}, teamAbbrev, value, headshot}], savePctg:[…], goalsAgainstAverage:[…], shutouts:[…]}

tools.name: nhl_player
tools.desc: One player's landing page: bio, draft details, current season splits, career totals and awards.
tools.example: {playerId, firstName, lastName, position, sweaterNumber, currentTeamAbbrev, birthDate, birthCity, birthCountry, draftDetails:{year, round, overallPick, teamAbbrev}, featuredStats, careerTotals:{regularSeason, playoffs}, seasonTotals:[…], awards:[{trophy, seasons}]}

tools.name: nhl_roster
tools.desc: A club's full roster for one season, split into forwards / defensemen / goalies with bio, height/weight, shoots-catches and birthplace.
tools.example: {forwards:[…], defensemen:[…], goalies:[{id, firstName, lastName, sweaterNumber, positionCode, shootsCatches, heightInInches, weightInPounds, birthDate, birthCity, birthCountry, headshot}]}  — three parallel arrays, NOT one `players` list

tools.name: nhl_schedule
tools.desc: League schedule for the current week (or a given date's week), grouped by day.
tools.example: {gameWeek:[{date, dayAbbrev, numberOfGames, games:[{id, startTimeUTC, gameState, gameType, homeTeam:{abbrev, score}, awayTeam:{…}, venue}]}], regularSeasonStartDate, regularSeasonEndDate, playoffEndDate, nextStartDate, previousStartDate}

tools.name: nhl_scores
tools.desc: Live scoreboard: every game on a date with current score, clock and period.
tools.example: {currentDate, prevDate, nextDate, games:[{id, gameState, gameScheduleState, startTimeUTC, homeTeam:{abbrev, score, sog}, awayTeam:{…}, clock:{timeRemaining, running, inIntermission}, periodDescriptor:{number, periodType}, goals:[…]}], gameWeek:[…]}

tools.name: nhl_seasons
tools.desc: Every season the standings API covers, with its start/end dates and which rules applied — call this to get valid season ids.
tools.example: {currentDate, seasons:[{id:20242025, standingsStart, standingsEnd, conferencesInUse, divisionsInUse, tiesInUse, wildcardInUse, pointForOTlossInUse}]}  — `id` is the concatenated-year season format every other tool wants

tools.name: nhl_skater_leaders
tools.desc: League leaders among skaters — goals, assists, points, plus-minus, power-play and short-handed goals, penalty minutes, ice time.
tools.example: {goals:[{id, firstName:{default}, lastName:{default}, teamAbbrev, position, value, headshot}], assists:[…], points:[…], plusMinus:[…], goalsPp:[…], goalsSh:[…], penaltyMins:[…], toi:[…]}  — one array per category

tools.name: nhl_standings
tools.desc: League standings with division/conference/wildcard sequencing and clinch indicators.
tools.example: {standings:[{teamName:{default}, teamAbbrev:{default}, conferenceName, divisionName, gamesPlayed, wins, losses, otLosses, points, pointPctg, goalFor, goalAgainst, goalDifferential, divisionSequence, conferenceSequence, wildcardSequence, l10Wins, streakCode, streakCount, clinchIndicator}], wildCardIndicator, standingsDateTimeUtc}

tools.name: nrl_application_settings
tools.desc:
NRL match-centre application config: the current-season competition list
(competitionList), stat-grid column layouts (dataGrids), UI components and
team/competition image paths. Handy for discovering the active competitionIds
and which statistics the official site surfaces.
tools.example: {applicationInfo, userInfo, competitionList, components, dataGrids, shellGroups}

tools.name: nrl_competitions
tools.desc:
Global Champion Data competition catalogue. Returns every competition id
(NRL, State of Origin, plus other Champion Data sports) with its season and
round count. Find the NRL competitionId here (e.g. 12999 = 2026 NRL Premiership,
13009 = 2026 State of Origin) to pass to nrl_fixture / nrl_match.
tools.example: {competitionDetails:{competition:[{id, name, season, rounds, regulationPeriods, regulationPeriodLength}]}}

tools.name: nrl_fixture
tools.desc:
Full fixture + results for one competition. One entry per match with round,
status, kickoff times (local + UTC), home/away squad ids/names/scores and venue.
Use it to list a round's games and to resolve the matchId for nrl_match.
tools.example: {fixture:{match:[{matchId, roundNumber, matchStatus, utcStartTime, localStartTime, homeSquadId, homeSquadName, homeSquadScore, awaySquadId, awaySquadName, awaySquadScore, venueId, venueName}]}}

tools.name: nrl_match
tools.desc:
Full match file: per-player match statistics (tries, tackles, runMetres,
lineBreaks, tryAssists, offloads, handlingErrors, metresGained, …), per-period
player stats, team/player rosters, period durations, sin bins and on-report
records. This is the per-player, per-match stat source. Decode stat codes via
the nrl://stats/definitions resource.
tools.example: {matchStats:{matchInfo, teamInfo:{team[]}, playerInfo:{player[]}, periodInfo:{qtr[]}, playerStats:{player[]}, playerPeriodStats:{player[]}, sinBins:{binned[]}, reports:{onReport[]}, created}, jobId}

tools.name: oddsapiio_bookmakers
tools.desc: The 274 bookmakers indexed, and whether each is currently active. VERIFIED live — works without a key.
tools.example: [{name:'10BET', active:true}]

tools.name: oddsapiio_events
tools.desc: Upcoming events for a sport or league, without prices. NEEDS A KEY.
tools.example: [{id, sport, league, home, away, starts, status}]

tools.name: oddsapiio_leagues
tools.desc: Leagues within a sport. NEEDS A KEY.
tools.example: [{id, name, country, sport}]

tools.name: oddsapiio_odds
tools.desc: Odds for one event across the indexed bookmakers. NEEDS A KEY.
tools.example: {id, home, away, starts, bookmakers:{'<bookmaker name>':{markets…}}}

tools.name: oddsapiio_sports
tools.desc: The 34 sports covered, with the slug every other tool needs. VERIFIED live — works without a key.
tools.example: [{name:'Football', slug:'football'}]

tools.name: opendota_hero_stats
tools.desc: Per-hero win and pick counts broken down by skill bracket — the hero meta.
tools.example: [{id, localized_name, pro_pick, pro_win, pro_ban, 1_pick, 1_win, …, 8_pick, 8_win}]  — the numeric prefixes are skill brackets (1=lowest … 8=highest); win rate is <n>_win / <n>_pick, NOT a percentage field

tools.name: opendota_heroes
tools.desc: The hero catalogue — id, name, primary attribute, attack type and roles.
tools.example: [{id, name:'npc_dota_hero_antimage', localized_name:'Anti-Mage', primary_attr:'agi', attack_type:'Melee', roles:[str], legs}]  (top-level array, ~127 heroes)

tools.name: opendota_leagues
tools.desc: Every Dota 2 league/tournament OpenDota knows. LARGE (~1 MB) — includes years of historical events.
tools.example: [{leagueid, name, tier:'premium'|'professional'|'amateur', ticket, banner}]  (~1 MB — filter client-side by tier)

tools.name: opendota_match
tools.desc: Full detail for one match: every player's hero, items, KDA, gold/XP curves and objectives. LARGE (~250 KB).
tools.example: {match_id, duration, radiant_win, radiant_score, dire_score, league, players:[{account_id, hero_id, player_slot, kills, deaths, assists, gold_per_min, xp_per_min, last_hits, hero_damage, items, gold_t:[…], xp_t:[…]}], objectives, picks_bans, teamfights}  — player_slot < 128 means Radiant

tools.name: opendota_player
tools.desc: A player's profile with rank tier and estimated MMR.
tools.example: {profile:{account_id, personaname, name, avatarfull, steamid, country_code, is_pro}, rank_tier, leaderboard_rank, competitive_rank}  — rank_tier is two digits: tens=medal (1 Herald … 8 Immortal), units=star

tools.name: opendota_player_heroes
tools.desc: Which heroes a player uses and how they perform on each.
tools.example: [{hero_id, games, win, with_games, with_win, against_games, against_win, last_played}]  — ordered by games played; join hero_id via opendota_heroes

tools.name: opendota_player_matches
tools.desc: A player's recent matches with hero, result and KDA.
tools.example: [{match_id, player_slot, radiant_win, duration, hero_id, kills, deaths, assists, start_time, lane_role}]  — you won a match when (player_slot < 128) == radiant_win

tools.name: opendota_player_winloss
tools.desc: A player's win/loss totals, with the same filters as their match list.
tools.example: {win, lose}  — two integers

tools.name: opendota_pro_matches
tools.desc: Recent professional matches with teams, league, duration and result.
tools.example: [{match_id, duration, start_time, radiant_team_id, radiant_name, dire_team_id, dire_name, leagueid, league_name, series_id, series_type, radiant_score, dire_score, radiant_win}]  — Dota sides are RADIANT and DIRE, not home/away; `radiant_win` is the result

tools.name: opendota_public_matches
tools.desc: A sample of recent public (non-professional) matches — the ladder meta rather than the pro scene.
tools.example: [{match_id, start_time, duration, avg_rank_tier, radiant_win, radiant_team:[hero_id], dire_team:[hero_id]}]  — hero ids only, no player identity

tools.name: opendota_teams
tools.desc: Professional teams ranked by rating, with win/loss records.
tools.example: [{team_id, name, tag, rating, wins, losses, last_match_time, logo_url}]  (~250 KB, ordered by rating)

tools.name: openf1_car_data
tools.desc: Car telemetry at ~3.7 Hz — speed, throttle, brake, gear, RPM, DRS. HIGH VOLUME: always pass session_key + driver_number.
tools.example: [{date, driver_number, speed, throttle, brake, n_gear, rpm, drs, session_key}]  (top-level array; large — use date>=/date<= operators on the raw API to window it)

tools.name: openf1_championship_drivers
tools.desc: Drivers' championship standings around a race — points and position before/after the session.
tools.example: [{driver_number, position_start, position_current, points_start, points_current, session_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_championship_teams
tools.desc: Constructors' championship standings around a race — points and position before/after the session.
tools.example: [{team_name, position_start, position_current, points_start, points_current, session_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_drivers
tools.desc: Drivers entered in a session — number, name, acronym, team and colours. Pass session_key (or 'latest').
tools.example: [{driver_number, full_name, name_acronym, broadcast_name, team_name, team_colour, headshot_url, session_key, meeting_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_intervals
tools.desc: Live gap data during a race — each driver's gap to the leader and interval to the car ahead, sampled over time.
tools.example: [{date, driver_number, gap_to_leader, interval, session_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_laps
tools.desc: Per-lap timing for a driver — lap + sector durations, speed-trap (i1/i2/st) speeds, mini-sector segment colours, pit-out flag.
tools.example: [{driver_number, lap_number, lap_duration, duration_sector_1/2/3, i1_speed, i2_speed, st_speed, is_pit_out_lap, segments_sector_1/2/3, date_start}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_location
tools.desc: Car (x, y, z) track position at ~3.7 Hz. HIGH VOLUME: always pass session_key + driver_number (and ideally a date window on the raw API).
tools.example: [{date, driver_number, x, y, z, session_key}]  (top-level array; large)

tools.name: openf1_meetings
tools.desc: Grand Prix weekends (meetings). Filter by year/country, or pass meeting_key=latest for the current event.
tools.example: [{meeting_key, meeting_name, meeting_official_name, country_name, country_code, circuit_short_name, location, year, date_start}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_overtakes
tools.desc: Overtake events in a race — who passed whom, when, and for which position.
tools.example: [{date, overtaking_driver_number, overtaken_driver_number, position, session_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_pit
tools.desc: Pit stops — lap, total time in pit lane and stationary stop duration per driver.
tools.example: [{date, driver_number, lap_number, pit_duration, lane_duration, stop_duration, session_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_position
tools.desc: Driver track position over time — position changes throughout a session.
tools.example: [{date, driver_number, position, session_key, meeting_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_race_control
tools.desc: Race-control messages — flags, safety cars, incidents, investigations, penalties — the official message feed.
tools.example: [{date, category, flag, scope, sector, lap_number, driver_number, message, session_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_session_result
tools.desc: Final classification of a session — per-driver position, laps, points, gap, DNF/DNS/DSQ flags.
tools.example: [{position, driver_number, number_of_laps, points, dnf, dns, dsq, duration, gap_to_leader, session_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_sessions
tools.desc: F1 sessions (Practice / Qualifying / Sprint / Race). This is the fixtures feed — filter by year, country or session_name to find a session_key.
tools.example: [{session_key, session_name, session_type, date_start, date_end, meeting_key, circuit_short_name, country_name, year}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_starting_grid
tools.desc: Race starting grid — per-driver grid position and lap time. (Sparse feed: OpenF1 returns a 404 'No results found' for sessions where no grid is published, which is currently most of them.)
tools.example: [{position, driver_number, lap_duration, session_key, meeting_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_stints
tools.desc: Tyre stints — compound and tyre age per driving period (lap_start → lap_end).
tools.example: [{stint_number, driver_number, lap_start, lap_end, compound, tyre_age_at_start, session_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_team_radio
tools.desc: Team-radio clips — recording URLs of driver/pit-wall radio exchanges during a session.
tools.example: [{date, driver_number, recording_url, session_key, meeting_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openf1_weather
tools.desc: Track weather, updated ~once a minute — air/track temperature, humidity, pressure, wind, rainfall.
tools.example: [{date, air_temperature, track_temperature, humidity, pressure, wind_speed, wind_direction, rainfall, session_key}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: openligadb_current_matchday
tools.desc: Which matchday a league is currently on — resolve 'this week' without guessing.
tools.example: {groupID, groupName:'1. Spieltag', groupOrderID}  — a single object, not a list

tools.name: openligadb_leagues
tools.desc: Every competition + season OpenLigaDB carries — call this to find the league shortcut and season year the other tools need.
tools.example: [{leagueId, leagueName, leagueShortcut:'bl1', leagueSeason:'2024', sport:{sportId, sportName}}]  (~819 entries, ~120 KB)

tools.name: openligadb_match
tools.desc: One match by id, with goals and scorers.
tools.example: {matchID, matchDateTime, team1, team2, matchIsFinished, matchResults:[…], goals:[{goalID, scoreTeam1, scoreTeam2, matchMinute, goalGetterName, isPenalty, isOwnGoal}], location}

tools.name: openligadb_matchday_matches
tools.desc: One matchday's fixtures and results — the everyday call.
tools.example: Same shape as openligadb_season_matches, restricted to one matchday (~9 matches for the Bundesliga)

tools.name: openligadb_matchdays
tools.desc: The matchdays ('groups') in a season — OpenLigaDB calls a Spieltag a 'group'.
tools.example: [{groupID, groupName:'1. Spieltag', groupOrderID}]  — groupOrderID is the matchday number the match tools take

tools.name: openligadb_season_matches
tools.desc: Every match in a league season with results. LARGE (~550 KB for a Bundesliga season) — prefer the matchday tool.
tools.example: [{matchID, matchDateTime, matchDateTimeUTC, timeZoneID, leagueName, leagueSeason, group:{groupName, groupOrderID}, team1:{teamId, teamName}, team2:{…}, matchIsFinished, matchResults:[{resultName:'Endergebnis'|'Halbzeit', pointsTeam1, pointsTeam2}], goals:[…], location}]

tools.name: openligadb_table
tools.desc: The league table for a season.
tools.example: [{teamInfoId, teamName, shortName, points, opponentGoals, goals, matches, won, lost, draw, goalDiff, teamIconUrl}]  — ordered top to bottom; `goals` is scored, `opponentGoals` is conceded

tools.name: openligadb_teams
tools.desc: The clubs contesting one league season.
tools.example: [{teamId, teamName, shortName, teamIconUrl, teamGroupName}]

tools.name: pandascore_leagues
tools.desc: Leagues (the recurring competitions tournaments belong to).
tools.example: [{id, name, slug, image_url, url, videogame:{id, name, slug}, series:[…]}]

tools.name: pandascore_match_odds
tools.desc: Betting markets and prices for one esports match — the part `opendota` cannot give you.
tools.example: {match_id, markets:[{name, bookmakers:[{name, odds:[{name, value, ...}]}]}]}

tools.name: pandascore_matches
tools.desc: Matches across every title, or one — upcoming, running or past.
tools.example: [{id, name, slug, status, begin_at, end_at, number_of_games, opponents:[{type, opponent:{id, name, acronym, image_url}}], results:[{team_id, score}], league:{id, name}, serie, tournament, videogame, winner_id, live:{supported, url}}]  (top-level array; totals in X-Total header)

tools.name: pandascore_players
tools.desc: Esports players with role, nationality and current team.
tools.example: [{id, name, first_name, last_name, role, nationality, image_url, current_team:{id, name, acronym}, current_videogame}]

tools.name: pandascore_series
tools.desc: Series — a league's seasonal editions (e.g. 'LEC Summer 2025').
tools.example: [{id, name, full_name, slug, season, year, begin_at, end_at, league:{id, name}, videogame, winner_id}]

tools.name: pandascore_teams
tools.desc: Esports teams with their current rosters.
tools.example: [{id, name, acronym, slug, image_url, location, current_videogame, players:[{id, name, first_name, last_name, role, nationality}]}]

tools.name: pandascore_tournaments
tools.desc: Tournaments — upcoming, running or past — optionally for one title.
tools.example: [{id, name, slug, begin_at, end_at, prizepool, tier, league:{id, name}, serie:{id, full_name}, videogame, teams:[…]}]

tools.name: pandascore_videogames
tools.desc: The titles PandaScore covers, with the slug every other tool needs. Call this first rather than guessing a slug.
tools.example: [{id, name:'Counter-Strike', slug:'cs-go', current_version}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pinnacle_carousel
tools.desc: Featured matchups carousel across all sports (homepage highlights).
tools.example: [{id, league:{name}, participants:[{name}], startTime, hasMarkets, hasLive}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pinnacle_enums
tools.desc: Reference enums (countries, currencies, occupations, etc.) used across the API.
tools.example: {countries:[{code2, code3, legalAge, license:{name}}], ...}

tools.name: pinnacle_labels
tools.desc: Per-sport market-label dictionary — decodes market keys/types into human names (moneyline → 'Match Odds', etc.).
tools.example: [{sport, labels:[{marketLabels:[{full, short, type}]}]}]  (top-level array, one per sport)

tools.name: pinnacle_league_matchups
tools.desc: All matchups for one league (competition) — e.g. every NBA game on the board.
tools.example: [{id, league:{name}, participants:[{name, alignment}], startTime, hasMarkets, isLive}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pinnacle_league_matchups_live
tools.desc: Live (in-play) matchups for one league (competition).
tools.example: [{id, league:{name}, participants:[{name}], startTime, isLive, liveMode}]  (top-level array; empty when nothing live)

tools.name: pinnacle_matchup
tools.desc: One matchup's detail: participants, league, periods, start time, state.
tools.example: {id, league:{name}, participants:[{name, alignment}], periods:[...], startTime, state, type, rotation}

tools.name: pinnacle_matchup_markets
tools.desc: All straight (non-parlay) markets + American-odds prices for one matchup and its related markets.
tools.example: [{key, matchupId, period, cutoffAt, isAlternate, limits:[{amount, type}], prices:[{designation, points, price}]}]  (top-level array; price is American odds)

tools.name: pinnacle_matchup_parlay_markets
tools.desc: Parlay (same-game multi) markets + prices for one matchup and its related markets.
tools.example: [{key, matchupId, period, cutoffAt, limits:[{amount, type}], prices:[{designation, points, price}]}]  (top-level array; price is American odds)

tools.name: pinnacle_matchup_related
tools.desc: Matchups related to one matchup (the same event's sub-matchups / alternative lines).
tools.example: [{id, type, participants:[{name}], hasMarkets}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pinnacle_sport_leagues
tools.desc: Leagues (competitions) for one sport, with feature/group info.
tools.example: [{id, name, group, isFeatured, matchupCount}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pinnacle_sport_matchups
tools.desc: Highlighted matchups for one sport (teams, league, start time, market flags).
tools.example: [{id, league:{name}, participants:[{name, alignment}], startTime, hasMarkets, isLive}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pinnacle_sport_matchups_all
tools.desc: All matchups for one sport (the full list, not just highlighted).
tools.example: [{id, league:{name}, participants:[{name, alignment}], startTime, hasMarkets, isLive}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pinnacle_sport_matchups_live
tools.desc: Live (in-play) matchups for one sport.
tools.example: [{id, league:{name}, participants:[{name}], startTime, isLive, liveMode}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pinnacle_sports
tools.desc: All sports with their matchup counts and primary market type.
tools.example: [{id, name, primaryMarketType, matchupCount, isFeatured, isHidden}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pinnacle_sports_live
tools.desc: Sports that currently have live (in-play) matchups.
tools.example: [{id, name, matchupCount, primaryMarketType}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pinnacle_status
tools.desc: API system status (online/offline + per-service health).
tools.example: {code, description, services:[{name, status}]}

tools.name: pinnacle_teasers
tools.desc: Teaser bet definitions (point teasers by sport group and team count).
tools.example: [{id, description, groupId, groupName, leagues:[{league:{...}}]}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pointsbet_competition_events
tools.desc: Featured events for one competition (paged) with their insight/featured markets.
tools.example: {key, name, nextPage, events:[{key, name, insightMarkets:[], featuredMarkets:[]}]}

tools.name: pointsbet_content_call
tools.desc:
Fetch one of PointsBet's static CMS / navigation JSON assets from
pointsbet.com.au by operation name (no params). These drive the site's
menus, tiles, logo mappings, build manifest and maintenance banner. Read
pointsbet://content/operations for the operation list.

tools.name: pointsbet_event
tools.desc: Full event detail: all fixed-odds markets + selections + prices, SGM, team stats, insights.
tools.example: {key, name, competitionName, startsAt, fixedOddsMarkets:[{name, outcomes:[{name, price}]}], prePricedSgm:{}, homeTeamStats:{}}

tools.name: pointsbet_event_search
tools.desc: Search sport events by class / competition, optionally with historic head-to-head stats.
tools.example: {events:[{key, name, competitionKey, startsAt, homeTeam, awayTeam}]}

tools.name: pointsbet_events_nextup
tools.desc: Next-up sport events across all codes, ordered by start time (homepage feed).
tools.example: {events:[{key, name, sportKey, competitionName, startsAt, homeTeam, awayTeam, isLive}]}

tools.name: pointsbet_inplay_streaming
tools.desc: In-play events that carry a live video stream, grouped by sport.
tools.example: {sports:[{key, name, events:[{key, name, visionData:[]}]}], numberOfInPlayEvents}

tools.name: pointsbet_preprice_multis
tools.desc: Pre-priced "5 for $25" multi suggestions (one pre-built multi per featured event).
tools.example: [{key, name, competitionName, startsAt, homeTeam, awayTeam, ...preBuilt legs}]

tools.name: pointsbet_promo_code
tools.desc: Sign-up splash content (info text + hero image) for a named promo code.
tools.example: {info, image}

tools.name: pointsbet_promotions
tools.desc: Live promotions for a display surface (carousel, etc.) from the promotions service.
tools.example: [{id, type, title, description, ...}]

tools.name: pointsbet_racing_featured
tools.desc: Featured races across codes with a preview of their top runners.
tools.example: [{raceId, racingType, name, venue, number, advertisedStartTimeUtc, runners:[]}]

tools.name: pointsbet_racing_form
tools.desc: Detailed form guide for one race: tips, predicted order and per-runner history.
tools.example: {RaceId, RaceNumber, RaceName, RacePreview:{PredictedOrder:[]}, RaceTips:[{Comment}]}

tools.name: pointsbet_racing_futures
tools.desc: Racing futures markets (Cup/Carnival outrights and other long-running racing markets).
tools.example: {events:[{key, name, competitionName, startsAt}]}

tools.name: pointsbet_racing_hourly_quaddie
tools.desc: Hourly Quaddie schedule — the four-leg quaddie races grouped by hour.
tools.example: [{date, hour, advertisedHourUtc, races:[{raceId, venue, number, advertisedStartTimeUtc}]}]

tools.name: pointsbet_racing_insights
tools.desc: Editorial form insights for one race (may be empty / 204 before they are published).
tools.example: {raceId, insights:[{heading, body}]}  (204 No Content when none yet)

tools.name: pointsbet_racing_meeting
tools.desc: One race meeting by id: venue, conditions, and the full list of its races.
tools.example: {meetingId, venue, racingType, meetingStartDateTimeUtc, races:[{raceId, raceNumber, name}]}

tools.name: pointsbet_racing_meetings
tools.desc: All race meetings (every code) for a date window, each with its races.
tools.example: [{groupLabel, meetings:[{meetingId, venue, racingType, races:[{raceId, raceNumber, advertisedStartTimeUtc}]}]}]

tools.name: pointsbet_racing_race
tools.desc: Full racecard for one race: runners, prices, track/conditions, plus results + dividends once run.
tools.example: {raceId, name, venue, number, trackCondition, runners:[{number, name, price}], results:{winners:[], straightDividends:[]}}

tools.name: pointsbet_racing_races
tools.desc: Racecards for several races in one call (batch by race ids).
tools.example: [{raceId, name, venue, number, runners:[{number, name, price}]}]

tools.name: pointsbet_racing_srm
tools.desc: Same Race Multi (SRM) market for one race (availability + legs/prices when open).
tools.example: {marketType, displayName, isAvailable, availabilityTimeUtc, legs:[]}

tools.name: pointsbet_racing_tips
tools.desc: Tipster selections for a racing code + country for today, grouped by venue.
tools.example: [{date, racingType, venue:{name, stateCode}, tips:[{tipster:{name}, links}]}]

tools.name: pointsbet_sport_competitions
tools.desc: Competitions for one sport, grouped by locale (Featured / country buckets).
tools.example: {key, name, locales:[{key, name, competitions:[{key, name, numberOfEvents}]}]}

tools.name: pointsbet_sport_featured_events
tools.desc: Featured (highlighted) events for one sport (event headers; call pointsbet_event for markets).
tools.example: {key, name, events:[{key, name, competitionKey, startsAt, homeTeam, awayTeam}]}

tools.name: pointsbet_sports_inplay
tools.desc: Sports currently in-play, with a live event count per sport.
tools.example: {sports:[{key, name, numberOfInPlayEvents}], numberOfInPlayEvents}

tools.name: pointsbet_sports_list
tools.desc: Full catalogue of sports and their competitions (every code, featured flags).
tools.example: {sports:[{key, name, competitions:[{key, name, isFeatured}]}]}

tools.name: polymarket_book
tools.desc: Full order book (bids + asks with sizes) for one outcome token.
tools.example: {market, asset_id, bids:[{price, size}], asks:[{price, size}], tick_size, neg_risk, timestamp}

tools.name: polymarket_clob_markets
tools.desc: CLOB market catalogue (condition ids, token pairs, tick sizes) — cursor-paginated; the trading-plane view of the same markets.
tools.example: {limit, count, next_cursor, data:[{condition_id, question, market_slug, tokens:[{token_id, outcome}], minimum_tick_size, active, closed}]}

tools.name: polymarket_event
tools.desc: One event by Gamma id, with all its markets.
tools.example: {id, title, slug, description, volume, liquidity, endDate, tags, markets:[…]}

tools.name: polymarket_events
tools.desc: Event catalogue (an event groups related markets, e.g. one game or election) with nested markets.
tools.example: [{id, title, slug, description, volume, liquidity, endDate, tags, markets:[{id, question, clobTokenIds, outcomePrices}]}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: polymarket_holders
tools.desc: Top holders of a market's outcome tokens.
tools.example: [{token, holders:[{proxyWallet, amount, name, …}]}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: polymarket_market
tools.desc: One market's full detail by Gamma id — question, outcomes + prices, CLOB token ids, volume/liquidity, resolution source.
tools.example: {id, question, description, slug, conditionId, clobTokenIds, outcomes, outcomePrices, volumeNum, liquidityNum, endDate, resolutionSource, events:[…]}

tools.name: polymarket_markets
tools.desc: Market catalogue with current outcome prices — filter/sort by activity, volume, liquidity, tag or slug.
tools.example: [{id, question, slug, conditionId, clobTokenIds, outcomes, outcomePrices, volumeNum, liquidityNum, volume24hr, endDate, active, closed, events:[…]}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: polymarket_midpoint
tools.desc: Midpoint (between best bid and best ask) for one outcome token.
tools.example: {mid}

tools.name: polymarket_price
tools.desc: Best price for one outcome token on one side of the book.
tools.example: {price}

tools.name: polymarket_price_history
tools.desc: Historical price series for one outcome token — by named interval or an explicit ts window.
tools.example: {history:[{t, p}]}  (unix seconds, price 0-1)

tools.name: polymarket_search
tools.desc: Site-wide search over events/markets/profiles by free-text query.
tools.example: {events:[…], tags:[…], profiles:[…]}

tools.name: polymarket_series
tools.desc: One series by Gamma id, with its events.
tools.example: {id, title, slug, seriesType, recurrence, events:[…]}

tools.name: polymarket_series_list
tools.desc: Series catalogue — a series groups recurring events (e.g. a league's season of games); the top of Gamma's series → events → markets hierarchy.
tools.example: [{id, title, slug, seriesType, recurrence, active, closed, volume, liquidity, events:[…]}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: polymarket_sports
tools.desc: Sports metadata catalogue — each sport with its tag ids, league/resolution links and series, the entry point for sports markets (feed tag_id into polymarket_markets/polymarket_events).

tools.name: polymarket_spread
tools.desc: Bid-ask spread for one outcome token.
tools.example: {spread}

tools.name: polymarket_tags
tools.desc: Tag catalogue (Sports, Politics, Crypto, NBA, …) — tag ids feed the tag_id filters.
tools.example: [{id, label, slug, forceShow, …}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: polymarket_trades
tools.desc: Public trade tape — recent fills, optionally for one market (condition id) or user.
tools.example: [{proxyWallet, side, asset, conditionId, size, price, timestamp, title, outcome}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pl_awards
tools.desc: Season awards — Player/Manager of the Month and other honours for a season.
tools.example: {player_awards:[…], manager_awards:[…]}

tools.name: pl_broadcast_match_events
tools.desc: Broadcast events for a specific match (sportDataId = SDP match id).

tools.name: pl_broadcasting_events
tools.desc: TV/broadcast schedule for a date range (ISO 8601 UTC).
tools.example: {pageInfo, content:[{match/broadcast schedule entries}]}

tools.name: pl_clubs_metadata
tools.desc: Club metadata (names, stadiums, websites, colours) for theming — static config blob.

tools.name: pl_competition
tools.desc: One competition by id (8 = Premier League).

tools.name: pl_competitions
tools.desc: All competitions on the platform (Premier League = id 8). Paginated.

tools.name: pl_content
tools.desc: Content list/search (articles, video, photos) — filter by content types, entity references (SDP_FOOTBALL_MATCH/PLAYER/TEAM) and tags.

tools.name: pl_content_item
tools.desc: One content item by type + id (TEXT/VIDEO/PHOTO/PLAYLIST/PROMO/AUDIO).

tools.name: pl_country

tools.name: pl_current_gameweek

tools.name: pl_match
tools.desc: Single match detail (match centre) — richer than the list item; adds seasonInfo.

tools.name: pl_match_commentary
tools.desc: Live text commentary feed for a match (paginated).

tools.name: pl_match_events
tools.desc: Match events — goals, cards, subs split by home/away team, each with playerId, time, period, timestamp.

tools.name: pl_match_lineups
tools.desc: Match lineups — home_team/away_team players[] with formation and subs.

tools.desc: Latest news, smart-ranked (homepage feed).

tools.name: pl_news_popular
tools.desc: Popular news over the last `recency` hours, smart-ranked.
tools.example: [{title, author, contentSummary, canonicalUrl, date}]  (top-level array)

tools.name: pl_player
